name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, '3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: pyproject.toml
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest -v

  test-generated-project:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        database: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: pyproject.toml
    
    - name: Install uv
      run: |
        curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
        echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
    
    - name: Generate project
      run: |
        cookiecutter . --config-file test-config.yaml --no-input
        cd generated-project
        ls -la
        
    - name: Validate file structure
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        # Check for required files
        test -f "pyproject.toml" || exit 1
        test -f "README.md" || exit 1
        test -d "src" || exit 1
        
    - name: Check Python syntax
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +
        
    - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        grep -r "{{cookiecutter" . || true
        
    - name: Install dependencies with uv
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        uv sync --extra dev --extra test || echo "Some dependencies failed to install, continuing..."
        
    - name: Test basic imports
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        python -c "import src; print('Import successful')"

yaml:
name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, '3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: pyproject.toml
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest -v

  test-generated-project:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        database: [tortoise, beanie]
        docker: [true, false]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: pyproject.toml
    
    - name: Install uv
      run: |
        curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
        echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
    
    - name: Generate project
      run: |
        cookiecutter . --config-file test-config.yaml --no-input
        cd generated-project
        ls -la
        
    - name: Validate file structure
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        # Check for required files
        test -f "pyproject.toml" || exit 1
        test -f "README.md" || exit 1
        test -d "src" || exit 1
        
    - name: Check Python syntax
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +
        
    - name: Check for unreplaced template variables
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        grep -r "{{cookiecutter" . || true
        
    - name: Install dependencies with uv
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        uv sync --extra dev --extra test || echo "Some dependencies failed to install, continuing..."
        
    - name: Test basic imports
      run: |
        cd generated-project
        python -c "import src; print('Import successful')"
